{"proof":"  have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hz : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have him : Complex.I = 2 := by
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp he
    have him2 := congrArg Complex.im him
    norm_num at him2
  apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
  calc
    i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := h
    _ = (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) := by
      rw [Complex.I_mul_I]
      ring"}
